name: architecture-diagram-pair-benchmark
hard_failures: The artifact cannot be inspected in the requested or documented way.
The artifact materially invents architecture that the evidence explicitly contradicts.
A sequence request places asynchronous completion before the evidenced HTTP acceptance response.
The final artifact contains active untrusted content or an undeclared network dependency.
fairness_controls: Use the same evidence snapshot and exact user prompt for both configurations.
Expose only the assigned pair of visualization skills to each executor.
Do not prescribe TypeScript, HTML, or Mermaid unless output-format compliance is the behavior under test.
Grade authoritative source accuracy separately from rendered projection fidelity.
Randomize anonymous A/B order and repeat the comparison with the order reversed.
Macro-average architecture families and requested view types so microservice cases do not dominate the result.
Report capability by view type as well as the overall quality score.
